verdicts.notes: Spot-checked 4 of 24: zach/chime (8/8 subbands, S/N 21-85, systematic curved deviation from the nu^-2 line at +-20 sigma normalized residuals, chi2_red 173 -- profile evolution across the band, not a DM error; the sigma under-quote mechanism in one image); casey/dsa (0/8 subbands as grey verticals vs coarse peak S/N 158 in the title -- the subband-gate paradox, Phase-2 entry); oran/dsa (3/8 subbands, large honest errors, chi2_red 0.02, sigma 0.15); mahi/chime (2/8 on a non-detection, correctly gated; NOTE: the 575 MHz subband reports an absurd S/N 2.3e10 from a degenerate EMG fit -- excluded from the DM by the gate, flagged as a Phase-2 hardening item to sanity-cap subband S/N).

Red candidate lines sit on curve peaks for all constrained panels. All 7 unconstrained panels (mahi/chime 'only 2 sub-bands'; casey/freya/hamilton/isha/phineas/mahi DSA 'only 0-2 sub-bands above S/N 4.0') still show clearly peaked coarse curves at 0 -- confirms the subband-gate config-sensitivity finding, not non-detections. oran/chime is the weakest constrained curve (-0.33 +- 0.33, noise-dominated), consistent with its known CHIME near-non-detection.

Sharp coherent-power peaks at 0 on bright CHIME products (casey, freya, hamilton, zach). Known CHIME non-detections are noise curves; note oran/chime picks a noise spike at +3.66 +- 0.32 and isha/chime at -3.01 +- 0.76 -- overconfident sigma on noise, matching the Phase-0 calibration finding. DSA panels broad but peaked (wilhelm/dsa a smooth dome, sigma 0.03 looks optimistic for that width). y-scales span 1e-33..1e7 across panels -- native metric units, expected.

All 24 panels populated, peaks near 0, red lines on-peak. DSA sigmas visibly larger (0.7-2.0) than CHIME as Phase 0 predicted for this geometry. isha/dsa and mahi/dsa near-noise with sigma ~1-2 (honest). No empty panels or axis artifacts.

Post-fix render: every panel shows the +-1 fine window around the coarse center with the red candidate inside and the grey 'package exposes no search curve' note; no more auto-scaled micro-ranges. Non-detections self-flag: mahi/chime -3.28 +- 489.39, oran/chime -1.83 +- 18.52. isha/dsa -0.67 +- 0.00 has a suspiciously zero sigma -- noted for the memo, not a plotting artifact.

Peaked log-power curves near 0 on bright products, red lines on-peak. Exactly one unconstrained panel: casey/chime 'LinAlgError: SVD did not converge' (deterministic with seeded RNG; recorded finding). Weak-geometry DSA products (mahi +-2.16, isha +-3.19, oran +-1.18, zach +-2.32) show flat noisy curves with honestly large sigma.

Spot-checked 4 of 120: casey_dsa_arrival_regression (unconstrained yet burst clearly visible and curve peaked -- the gate finding in one image); zach_chime_dm_power_published (+0.032 +- 0.020, curve peak, waterfalls aligned, profile sharpest at candidate); mahi_chime_dmphase_variant_intree (non-detection: noise curve, no burst in waterfall, honest +-0.99); chromatica_dsa_dm_phase_published (+0.493 +- 0.043, profile at candidate ~10x sharper than at reference -- consistent with the known file-stem 272.368 vs bursts.yaml 272.664 DM convention gap, cross-method agreement with arrival +0.29 and dmpower +0.28).
